# secobserve_parser (Data Source)

Looks up a single vulnerability scanner parser by name.

Parsers are system-managed: SecObserve registers them from its built-in parser modules at startup and they cannot be created or modified through the API. Use this data source to resolve a parser name to the numeric id required by `secobserve_api_configuration` and the rule resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve a parser name to the numeric id that api_configuration and the rule
# resources expect.
data "secobserve_parser" "dependency_track" {
  name = "Dependency Track"
}

output "parser_id" {
  value = data.secobserve_parser.dependency_track.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the parser, for example `Trivy Filesystem` or `Dependency Track`.

### Read-Only

- `class_name` (String) Python class implementing the parser.
- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the parser.
- `module_name` (String) Python module implementing the parser.
- `sbom` (Boolean) Whether the parser consumes an SBOM.
- `source` (String) How observations reach SecObserve: `API`, `File`, `Manual`, `Other` or `Unknown`. Only parsers with source `API` can be referenced by `secobserve_api_configuration`.
- `type` (String) Scanner category: `SCA`, `SAST`, `DAST`, `IAST`, `Secrets`, `Infrastructure`, `Other` or `Manual`.
